description: Compare two to five named banks on the editor-approved rates for savings, money market, checking or CDs (CDs by termMonths, default 12). For a balance, return each bank's APY, yearly interest, the gap to the best bank in your set and to the best verified rate, with verified date and source. Only banks in the approved set can be compared; a category with no current approved release returns data_unavailable and no rates. Illustrative interest before taxes, not a recommendation; verify eligibility and minimums.

accounts.description: Two to five bank names or ids, e.g. ["Ally", "Capital One"].
